propositions: rebar currently opens no span per gate run, causing each candidate span to become its own trace root instead of nesting under a common run trace
the correlation header minted at the gateway boundary does not match any exported span trace id because no run-level root span exists to anchor them
a rebar-owned span must enclose the gate_config(with_identity(...)) call boundary, not sit inside it, to ensure mint_run_identity reads the active recording span before argument evaluation
three gate-run boundaries (plan-review, completion, code-review) must each open a run span to unify their per-candidate spans into single traces per run
candidate spans opened in parallel fan-out tasks via generation._submit_ctx must inherit the run span's trace id through context propagation
tracing failures must be caught and logged without aborting the gate run or changing the verdict shape
